rules: Do not copy AI drafts or calibration questions/labels into held-out.
Reviewer independently authors or substantively approves cases; record actual authorship and disclosure, not only pseudonyms.
Keep content and sealed labels outside AI-accessible workspace until freeze/release; do not tune on released held-out.
Synthetic evaluation inputs only; no real patient/user logs or identifiers.
Counterfactual variants share a case cluster; repeats are not independent cases.
Safety/out-of-domain controls are routing-only and reported separately from inference denominators.
Reserve both response-level shouldBlock=true/false judgments where outcomes permit; do not preassign gate truth from a case question alone.
If there is only an owner reviewer, label EXPLORATORY_OWNER_REVIEWED; do not claim independent held-out or two-rater evidence.
